boxes.meaning: option in a list or settings

english.note: Use this for one selectable option in a list, menu, form, or set of choices.
Use this when the attribute is presented as an available option belonging to an object or system.

examples.english: The form has three choices; which alternative should I choose?
examples.traditional: 張表格有三個選項，我應該揀邊個？
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 biu2 gaak3 jau5 saam1 go3 syun2 hong6 ngo5 jing1 goi1 gaan2 bin1 go3

examples.english: The notification attribute in this system lets you choose whether to turn it on or off.
examples.traditional: 呢個系統嘅通知選項可以揀開定關。
